import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from core.ids import is_valid_household_id  # noqa: E402
from registry.register import load_households  # noqa: E402


def main() -> None:
    households = load_households(active_only=False)
    for h in households:
        head = h.members[0]
        print(f"{h.id} valid={is_valid_household_id(h.id)} status={h.status} "
              f"head={head.name!r} year={head.birth_year} size={h.size} "
              f"reg={h.registered}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
